text: Princess Nanaka, the leader of Leafy Sakura Village, is\nasking for your help to obtain a special treasure.\nLet's hurry to Mt. Black Peach to find the special treasure!
In the depths of Mt. Black Peach, you encounter the Black\nPeach ninjas, who have a deep-seated conflict with Leafy\nSakura. They refuse to hand over the treasure. Defeat them!
After obtaining the first treasure, Princess Nanaka asks you\nto help her obtain the second one.\nLet's hurry to Mt. White Peach to find it!
Princess Nanaka overhears your conversation with Caylass and\nthinks you've betrayed her. You have no choice but to fight\nnow! Defeat Princess Nanaka!
